title: Health
subtitle: Where the library hurts: missing subtitles, unmatched episodes, failing providers
more: More rows load as you scroll down.

no_result.label: No result
no_result.hint: Providers were asked and found nothing for this item.

no_result_slow.label: No result (slow)
no_result_slow.hint: Retry limit reached — now searched once a month.

provider_error.label: Provider error
provider_error.hint: Providers failed or were skipped: outage, rate limit, or budget.

file_missing.label: File missing
file_missing.hint: The media file is not where the record says — check the media path.

translation_error.label: Translation error
translation_error.hint: Found, but the translation backend could not finish it.

unsourceable.label: Unmatched
unsourceable.hint: Given up on: no provider could source this item.

failed.label: Failed
failed.hint: Failed without a recorded reason — see diagnostics.

auto_disabled.label: Auto-disabled
auto_disabled.hint: Turned off after repeated failures — re-enable it here.

circuit_open.label: Breaker open
circuit_open.hint: Circuit breaker tripped; requests are being held off.

credentials_rejected.label: Credentials rejected
credentials_rejected.hint: The stored key or account was refused — update it.

host_unreachable.label: Host unreachable
host_unreachable.hint: The provider's host could not be reached.

consecutive_failures.label: Failing
consecutive_failures.hint: Several requests in a row failed.

no_results.label: Delivers nothing
no_results.hint: Answers requests but never returns a result or download.

no_credentials.label: No credentials
no_credentials.hint: A required field is empty, so this provider never started.

not_initialized.label: Not initialized
not_initialized.hint: This provider was configured but never came up.

no_activity.label: Never asked
no_activity.hint: Nothing has searched through this provider yet.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.hint: The backend did not answer in time — raise its timeout.

line_mismatch.label: Line mismatch
line_mismatch.hint: The translation came back with a different line count.

backend_auth.label: Backend key rejected
backend_auth.hint: The translation backend refused the API key.

backend_quota.label: Budget exhausted
backend_quota.hint: Cost or request budget ran out for this backend.

backend_unreachable.label: Backend unreachable
backend_unreachable.hint: The backend host refused the connection.

source_missing.label: No source subtitle
source_missing.hint: Nothing to translate from — the source subtitle was never fetched.

signs_only.label: Signs only
signs_only.hint: The source subtitle is sign language, not dialogue.

unsupported_format.label: Unsupported format
unsupported_format.hint: The subtitle file is in a format Sublarr cannot read.

outside_media.label: Outside media folder
outside_media.hint: The file lies outside the media folder, so it cannot be processed.

job_error.label: Job failed
job_error.hint: The translation job broke before reaching a backend.

unknown.label: Problem
unknown.hint: A problem the page has no specific explanation for.

translation.summary: {{failures7d}} failed translations in the last 7 days · {{stuck}} items waiting to re-translate
